deviations.what: STATE-02 is asserted in the Angular form: a bound value / open that the application does not write back is the initial state; the action is reported once and the component follows it (hw-feedback shows the choice, hw-cookie-consent closes).
deviations.why: Convention controlled-and-observable-state: Angular has no controlled mode; a written value is the initial state and the component then updates its own field. Same form as the STATE-02 tests of the earlier Angular steps (rich-inputs.test.ts).

deviations.what: Package templates write the button and link markup literally (class hw-button / hw-link, type=button, data-variant, data-size) instead of applying hwButton / hwLink inside the component template.
deviations.why: Same rendered DOM as the specification; no directive instance per packaged button. Public names and output are unchanged.

deviations.what: The Link row of the README states that the former link component is removed and points to the migration line; the old names hw-link and HwLinkComponent are written only in the section 'Changed in 0.3.0 outside form controls'.
deviations.why: The specification asks for the removal note with the migration line and RENAME-01 asks that old names appear in no README. Old names are kept to the migration section, as for every other rename; the root RENAME-01 check has to exempt that section.
